notes: I added two broad positive humps: one centered near x≈45 (positive side, 30–60) and one near x≈-35 (negative side, -20 to -50), since the model was systematically underpredicting those regions (e.g. E16 44.2→0.0112, E20 -31.1→0.0194, -25.0→0.0177).
